purpose: Temporary cross-repository local-workerd composition of Auth workers_postgres_factory(execute) with the Runtime Host callback seam. It adds no permanent path dependency and is not Hyperdrive qualification.

input.authSource: An explicit versioned Auth candidate or source snapshot root containing crates/lenso-auth-oauth-flow-plugin/src/lib.rs and src/postgres_transport.rs.
input.command: An Auth-owned command invoked with its working directory set to authSource. It must build/run the real Auth Workers Host composition, not a mocked Rust or JavaScript transport.

environment.LENSO_AUTH_POSTGRES_COHORT_SOURCE_REVISI: The wrapper supplies the source revision or unversioned-source-snapshot label.

factorySecrecy: The Auth factory must receive only execute. It must not receive a D1/Hyperdrive binding name, connection string, credential, or retry authority.
doesNotQualify: real Hyperdrive or PostgreSQL provider behavior
